entities.summary: Taalaibek Omuraliev (b. 1965-05-02, Naryn) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Naryn and Kyrgyzstan. Known in the fields of kyrgyzstan, military leaders & commanders, asia.
